tei:div.tei:p: sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa shes rab zhabs drung du/ sgo gsum gus pas zhu gsol/ deng nyid dam pa bsnyun gzhi thad sprul sku rin po che'i gsung shog dang nyid nas gsung bris nyams med khug ma bcas 'byor bas/ 'di nas phreng mo btab pa la skyon cher med kyang*/ da ni bla ma rin po che'i dgung grangs yang mtho/ bsnyun gzhi yang glo nad 'di ngan che bas nad sna mang po 'dren 'dug pas/ sku tshe gcig la nyams len chos la byed pa'i don red pas/ rab tshe 'dir grol/ 'bring bar dor grol/ tha ma yin kyang skye ba phyi ma la grol ba yin pas/ nyid ni nyams len la rtse gcig tu brtson pas/ rab chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba/ rig pa snying gi nang nas yi ge a dkar por dmigs nas dbu ma'i lam nas spyi gtsug tu rgyang gis thon/ spyi bor nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i mod la rig pa spro bsdu dang bral bar bzhag nas 'pho ba bar do med par grol/ de min na rnam shes rlung zhon gyi 'pho ba rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yi ge hūm̐ yig sngon po khru gang ba'i rnam par bsgom nas bde ba can sogs su dpag chen gyi mda' 'phang ltar 'gro bar bsam nas nang nas hūm̐ ring bsgrang ba dang chab gcig 'pho ba'i dmigs pa bsgom pa ni 'pho ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin pas thugs la zhog gzhan yang bstan pa sems can gyi don du smon lam rgya chen po thob/ 'khor gsum po'i chags pa blos thongs/ 'chi ba la dga' ba sgoms/ da lta'i nad 'di yi sems can thams cad gyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad myong ba'i go chod dgos/ spyir sems can thams cad/ sgos rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i glud du 'gro snyam pa gyis/ sems bskyed rgya ma chung*/ phran nas gang shes kyis skyabs 'jug dang smon lam bgyid/ rang gi lag khar 'byor tshad kyi myong grol ril bu phul yod pas rtsis bzhes zhu/ mkhan ming pas phul zhus/// /
